title: 🎉 Oliver Collins awarded a Junior Research Assistant scholarship
summary: Oliver Collins, 2nd year student, has been awarded the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) scholarship for a project on illusions and bodily states.
content: Congratulations to Oliver Collins, 2nd year student, who has been awarded the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) scholarship!

Oliver will be working on a project exploring the relationship between illusions and bodily states, continuing the lab's interest in how perception and physiology shape each other. We are looking forward to seeing where this project takes him.
